title: Machine learning-optimized non-invasive brain stimulation and treatment response classification for major depression.
summary: The primary article applies SVM learning to modeled tDCS electric-field features to classify depression-treatment responders and identify regional response markers.
ai_technology: An SVM uses modeled current-density magnitudes, directions and vectors to distinguish responders.
organization: Center for Cognitive Aging and Memory; Department of Neuroscience

evidence.tested: Current-density magnitude is reported as the strongest classifier and contributing brain regions are identified.
evidence.unknown: The study evaluates treatment-response labels and compares feature representations, while limiting claims to the trial dataset.
evidence.ai_role: An SVM uses modeled current-density magnitudes, directions and vectors to distinguish responders.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
